title: Ab Initio Molecular Dynamics-Guided Machine-Learning Potentials for Mapping Nitric Oxide Interactions with Oxygen-Covered Graphite
summary: For NO interacting with 33% bridge-site oxygen-covered graphite, attractive regions narrowed during vertical approach and short-range repulsion decreased upon molecular reorientation. Exploratory AIMD also produced an NO2-forming trajectory after rebound and a reactive encounter; this is a modeled pathway, not experimental observation. Four independently initialized models were compared against an independent 2,000-configuration DFT test set. The selected model had energy and force-magnitude RMSEs of 0.0456 eV and 0.0303 eV/Å. The authors use these results to guide further first-principles sampling.
ai_technology: Deep-potential machine-learning interatomic potentials trained on ab initio molecular-dynamics configurations were used to relax 300 NO adsorption configurations and construct spatial and angular interaction maps.
organization: Department of Chemistry, University of California, Berkeley, Berkeley, California, USA
